```sql
WITH 
  known_districts AS (
    SELECT 'Gaya' AS district UNION SELECT 'Nalanda' AS district
  ),
  known_source AS (
    SELECT 'synthetic Bihar ANC fixture' AS source
  ),
  data AS (
    SELECT 
      year,
      district,
      pregnancies_registered,
      anc4_completed,
      source
    FROM anc_visits
    WHERE district IN (SELECT district FROM known_districts)
    AND source IN (SELECT source FROM known_source)
  ),
  rates AS (
    SELECT 
      year,
      district,
      pregnancies_registered,
      anc4_completed,
      pregnancies_registered AS denominator,
      pregnancies_registered - anc4_completed AS numerator
    FROM data
  ),
  rate_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
      district,
      numerator,
      denominator
    FROM rates
    WHERE year = 2021
  ),
  rate_2023 AS (
    SELECT 
      district,
      numerator,
      denominator
    FROM rates
    WHERE year = 2023
  ),
  percent_change AS (
    SELECT 
      district,
      NULLIF((rate_2023.numerator - rate_2021.numerator) * 100 / NULLIF(rate_2023.denominator - rate_2021.denominator, 1), NULL) AS percent_change
    FROM rate_2021
    JOIN rate_2023 ON rate_2021.district = rate_2023.district
  )
SELECT 
  district,
  percent_change
FROM percent_change
ORDER BY district;
```
